## Kyoto 5-Day Budget Trip Overview
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg

A balanced Kyoto plan for **2 adults**, designed to stay **under 12 km walking per day**, mix **temples + food + one low-effort nature activity**, and fit a **$1,800 total budget excluding flights**.
**Best fit:** central Kyoto base, transit between districts, 1 scenic boat/river day, and mostly clustered sightseeing.

## Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary and Cost Plan
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg

| Day | Focus | Walking | Estimated Cost for 2 | Best Fit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| Apr 10 | Higashiyama classics + Gion food | 7–10 km | **$280** | First-day temple loop |
| Apr 11 | Arashiyama nature + bamboo + river | 6–9 km | **$320** | Low-effort nature day |
| Apr 12 | Central Kyoto temples + markets | 5–8 km | **$290** | Food-forward city day |
| Apr 13 | Fushimi Inari + sake district | 8–11 km | **$300** | Iconic early start |
| Apr 14 | Philosopher’s Path + relaxed final meals | 6–9 km | **$270** | Gentle wrap-up day |

### Day 1: Higashiyama Temples + Gion Evening
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Kiyomizu-dera, Sannenzaka, Ninenzaka
- **Afternoon:** Kodai-ji, Yasaka Shrine, Maruyama Park
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/f8/A199_Japan_Kyoto_Maruyama_Park_Gion_Ar%C3%A9a_%284764445344%29.jpg Alt=Afternoon:** Kodai-ji, Yasaka Shrine, Maruyama Park, Kyoto, Japan
- **Food:** Matcha sweets, yudofu lunch, kaiseki-style dinner in Gion
- **Estimated cost:** lodging $150, food $70, transit $10, admissions $20, extras $30 = **$280**

### Day 2: Arashiyama Low-Effort Nature Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- **Morning:** Tenryu-ji, bamboo grove, Togetsukyo Bridge
- **Afternoon:** Hozugawa River area or short river cruise, monkey park only if energy is high
- **Food:** Tofu lunch, tofu skin snacks, dessert café near Arashiyama station
- **Estimated cost:** lodging $150, food $75, transit $15, admissions $30, extras $50 = **$320**

### Day 3: Central Kyoto Temples + Nishiki Market
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- **Morning:** Nijo Castle or Kyoto Imperial Palace grounds
- **Afternoon:** Nishiki Market, Teramachi shopping streets, short temple stop nearby
Media: Alt=Afternoon:** Nishiki Market, Teramachi shopping streets, short temple stop nearby, Kyoto, Japan
- **Food:** Market grazing, sushi, tamagoyaki, croquettes, dessert tea stop
- **Estimated cost:** lodging $150, food $85, transit $10, admissions $15, extras $30 = **$290**

### Day 4: Fushimi Inari + Sake District
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/signpost-split.svg
- **Morning:** Fushimi Inari Taisha early to avoid crowds
- **Afternoon:** Fushimi sake district, canal stroll, tasting room or brewery lunch
- **Food:** Inari sushi, sake-pairing lunch, local izakaya dinner
- **Estimated cost:** lodging $150, food $80, transit $12, admissions $8, extras $50 = **$300**

### Day 5: Philosopher’s Path + Gentle Farewell
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- **Morning:** Ginkaku-ji, Philosopher’s Path, Nanzen-ji area
- **Afternoon:** Café break, souvenir shopping, final temple stop if desired
- **Food:** Light lunch, wagashi, final Kyoto dinner near Kyoto Station
- **Estimated cost:** lodging $150, food $75, transit $10, admissions $15, extras $20 = **$270**

## Budget Fit and Best-Value Choices
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/currency-rupee.svg

- **Total estimated trip cost:** **$1,460**
- **Budget remaining:** **$340**
- This leaves room for:
  - a nicer dinner
  - extra snacks/cafés
  - a better hotel upgrade
  - taxi rides if needed

### Cost Breakdown by Category
| Category | 5-Day Estimate |
|---|---:|
| Lodging | **$750** |
| Food & drinks | **$385** |
| Transit | **$57** |
| Admissions | **$88** |
| Extras / buffer | **$180** |
| Total | **$1,460** |

### Practical Notes
- Staying in **central Kyoto, Kawaramachi, or near Kyoto Station** will help keep walking and transit simple.
- Your walking target is realistic if you use buses/subway between districts and keep each day clustered.
- For spring dates, **book lodging early** because Kyoto fills quickly during cherry blossom season.
